update.subject: Shipping update for order {number}

title.LABEL_CREATED: Your order is ready to ship
title.IN_TRANSIT: Your artwork is on its way
title.RETURNED: Your parcel came back to us

body.LABEL_CREATED: The artwork from order {number} is packed and ready to be handed to the carrier.
body.IN_TRANSIT: The artwork from order {number} was handed to the carrier and is on its way.
body.CUSTOMS: The parcel for order {number} is being cleared by customs in the destination country. As agreed at checkout (DAP), any import duties and taxes are collected from the recipient by the carrier.
body.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: The parcel for order {number} is with the courier and should be delivered today.
body.DELIVERED: The parcel for order {number} was delivered. We hope the artwork arrived safely.
body.EXCEPTION: The carrier reported a delay for the parcel of order {number}. We are following it; if the carrier contacts you, please reply to them. For any question, just reply to this email.
body.RETURNED: The parcel for order {number} came back to us. We will contact you to arrange what happens next.
body.COLLECTED: Thank you for collecting the artwork from order {number}.
body.OTHER: The shipping status of order {number} was updated.

update.dhl: Delivered by Deutsche Post DHL Group.
update.orderPage: The order details and the shipping status are always on your order page.

pickup.subject: Order {number} is ready for pickup
pickup.title: Your artwork is ready for pickup
pickup.body: The artwork from order {number} is packed and waiting for you at the studio.
pickup.schedule: Please arrange a pickup time in advance, by replying to this email or by phone.
pickup.disclosure: At pickup you will receive a printed copy of the disclosure document (the terms of the sale and your right to cancel).
